title: Sabhalal le numma gorrise
intro: Iggimaa kee dirab yallih qibaadah edde buulen waktit, kaxxa imaan safar yekke. ta numtin amo gexkalootu ken ayyuntih seeratitte, gorrisak inki numma gineenit aggiriqqe sinni kibal luk. milyoonul loowimta maritte uguugussuh raat cabtah tan roocih kinnaane yaybulleenimih gulguluh gaca.
clues: Anu qaran xagaritte essereh, kullim gineeh yassakaxxe numma degelta gorrisak.
Anu inni baaxo cabam amriseh suge, Yalli barkat le baaxo fan safar.
Anu inni ummattah sanamitte gexkalit abe, ken foyya saanih ken yaggileenimih foocal.
Anu inni ummatta cararta girat qide, takkay immay Yallih amrik xabca kee salaam yoh tekke.
Anu kiciyyoh an naharsi baxih baxa fida kah abannah amrit aqayyaare abeh suge, ellecabo xayyos gibbatu.
Anu, inni baxa luk, Ardi bagul naharsi Qibaadah Qari, inkih tan seehadayti baxih gicloh arac xisne.

outcome.label: Xalu
options: wale kee gitah tan samad yomcowweh suge
outcome.answer: wale kee gitah tan samad yomcowweh suge

arabic: قُلْنَا يَـٰنَارُ كُونِى بَرْدًۭا وَسَلَـٰمًا عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
verse: We [i.e., Allāh] said, "O fire, be coolness and safety upon Abraham." (21:69)
